device_memory_sampler.scope: The sampler starts during the AR run. The earlier 75% and 50% runs have no device samples.
device_memory_sampler.coverage_policy: Report sampled memory only when the timestamped samples cover the complete measurement interval. Preserve empty values for missing coverage.

source_equivalence.team-ffn-100: The optional probe is omitted by the recorded launch policy. Required checkpoint loader checks remain active.
